hotels.title: All-Inclusive Northern Territory Wilderness Luxury with Safari Bungalows, Gourmet Dining & Wildlife Safaris
hotels.description: There is nowhere quite like the regional and mesmerising Bamurru Plains. Sitting on over 300 square kilometres of private floodplain, bordering Kakadu National Park, this all-inclusive safari camp places guests inside one of Australia's most extraordinary wildlife environments. Just 12 bungalows and retreats share exclusive access to the floodplains, each with mesh walls that dissolve the boundary between inside and out. By night, listen to the Australian bush as wallabies and buffalo wander by. Twice daily, guided shared safaris venture across floodplains, through savanna woodland and along the Sampan to spot crocodiles and birdlife up close. Airboat and open-top safari drives await for a truly magical Australian wildlife experience. Every meal is prepared by an onsite chef and served in the main lodge, with afternoon canapes and sundowners built into your daily rhythm. Your stay includes unlimited free-flow drinks from the moment you arrive. Pour your way through a curated selection of Australian wines, cold beers and premium spirits, served throughout the resort with no limits. Sample these premium drinks in an ecosystem of quiet reflection, while children under 12 stay home awaiting their chance at this ultimate escape.
